title: A plan's check of a git hook item commits through the installed hook script
goal: skills/sprint/SKILL.md plan step 6 says an item that changes a git hook's behaviour carries a check that commits through the installed hook script (core.hooksPath in a scratch repo), not only a run of the tool the script calls. Found by the SP-kbrxa4c4 review (S4, ST-3mfjrjom): its check ran `kbgit.py hook commit-msg` directly and never `.githooks/commit-msg`, whose exit mapping blocks the commit.

run:
import sys
t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();i=t.find('## plan "<goal>"');s=t[i:t.find('\n## ',i+3)] if i>=0 else ''
ok='installed hook script' in s;print('## plan "<goal>"','names','installed hook script',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
